links.outcome: Comparison of ML early warning model against NEWS and simpler scores on discrimination and net benefit
links.effect: XGB-EWS AUC 0.932 vs DEWS 0.908, NEWS 0.902, NEWS-Light 0.879; max net benefit difference 1.8 additional correct mortality identifications per 10,000 patients between XGB-EWS and NEWS.
links.quote: Decision curve analysis showed maximum net benefit differences of 1·8 additional correct mortality identifications per 10 000 patients between XGB-EWS and NEWS, and 1·7 per 10 000 between NEWS and NEWS-Light, across the evaluated risk thresholds.

unlisted_practices: Using decision curve analysis and propensity score weighting to address intervention bias when evaluating early warning scores
Simplifying early warning scores to reduce workload (NEWS-Light) while maintaining net benefit

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter comparative validation study of machine learning vs rule-based early warning scores using decision curve analysis and causal inference; it evaluates model performance and net benefit trade-offs rather than testing a specific implementation practice or safeguard.
